cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You're so careful. I've saved the plates for you; I'll do the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the kitchen all to yourself.

mechanism: A graciously organizes a move, offering tools and preparation to keep B helping while converting a stated preference into an increasingly unavoidable plate-packing assignment.
confusable: Unlike ordinary generous delegation, A removes the offered choices; confidence depends on making the narrowed task comfortable enough for B to accept.
comparison: Packing fear and division of labor differ from eliminating a venue reservation after thanking the planner.
seedUse: Use D69-b books/plates/wrap/boxes chain and S02-a reinterpreting the helper concern as the intended allocation.
